about_body:
Version %1$s
A gaming companion to monitor your device, prepare settings, and record sessions.
limitations: No overclocking, clearing other apps’ RAM, locking FPS, or modifying game files. Performance results are not guaranteed.
welcome_body:
Prepare to play with real device data, recommendation profiles, and a personal library.

This app does not add RAM or change game FPS. App lists and history stay on your device. Sessions are recorded manually.
apply_manually: Apply recommendations manually in your game settings.
privacy_body:
Game Optimizer PRO does not send data to a server. It reads battery, memory, storage, connection status, and launchable apps for the dashboard and library.

Selected games, profiles, and up to 100 manual sessions are stored locally. No analytics, ads, accounts, or sale of data. Android backup is disabled. Language preferences stay on the device. Game icons come from installed apps.

Delete history in Settings, or delete all data through Android settings or uninstalling. Support: %1$s
